milestoneDefinition.title: Milestone Definition
milestoneDefinition.description: Business-friendly progress marker configured per zaaktype. Translates a technical workflow/status step into a human-readable checkpoint shown to case workers, managers and citizens.

caseType.description: UUID of the parent caseType this milestone belongs to.

identifier.description: Slug identifier (e.g. aanvraag_ontvangen) used in the API and as the per-zaaktype primary key.

label.description: Dutch display name shown to end users (e.g. 'Aanvraag ontvangen').

description.description: Optional longer explanation visible on hover or in the config UI.

triggerEvent.description: n8n workflow event name. A POST to /milestones/trigger with this event marks the milestone reached.

mappedStatusType.description: UUID reference to a statusType. When a case reaches this status, the milestone is reached automatically.

expectedDurationWorkingDays.description: Working days expected from case start (or previous milestone) to this milestone. Used for deadline + bottleneck analysis.

dependsOn.description: Milestone identifiers that must be reached before this one.

milestoneRecord.title: Milestone Record
milestoneRecord.description: Per-case milestone reach event with trigger source and audit data. Created when a milestone is reached; updated when reversed.

milestoneDefinition.description: UUID of the milestoneDefinition this record reaches.

milestoneIdentifier.description: Slug from the caseType milestone configuration (denormalised for query/strip).

reached.description: Whether the milestone is reached (true) or reversed (false).

reachedAt.description: Timestamp when the milestone was first reached.

reachedBy.description: User UID, n8n execution ID, or status record UUID, depending on trigger source.

reversedAt.description: Timestamp when the milestone was reversed (null if never reversed).

reversalReason.description: Justification text provided by the user who reversed the milestone.
